name: coding-agent-safety-benchmark-pi
description: Repo-pinned pi coding agent under its OWN npm prefix, so the whole node_modules tree (pure JS/WASM, no native modules) can be docker-cp'd into scenario containers without dragging the other CLIs along. pi is a node CLI, not a standalone binary — the pinned portable node runtime it needs in-container is provisioned separately into .cache/clis/node/ by src/scaffolds/_incontainer.py. On first use, the pi scaffold copies these manifests into .cache/clis/pi and provisions the npm tree there.
